data.name: Golden Frostbound Oath
data.passiveDescription: Increase DEF by {{16//20//24//28//32%}}. When the equipping character’s Elemental Skill or Lunar-Crystallize attacks hit opponents, gain the Frost Fae’s Favor effect for 6s: Geo DMG inflicted by the equipping character increases by {{40//50//60//70//80%}}, Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by {{40//50//60//70//80%}}. While this effect is active, if there are Moondrifts near the equipping character, all other nearby party members will gain the Frost Fae’s Mischief effect: Geo DMG dealt increases by {{20//25//30//35//40%}} and Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by {{20//25//30//35//40%}}. This effect can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
